description: D02 — 封闭局面的轻子最优布置

intro.popup_en:
Rapid Development, Practice 7
In a closed position, place the minor pieces on their best squares before activating the heavy pieces.
intro.popup:
快速出子第7局
在封闭局面中，轻子要找到最佳格子，然后再激活重子

outro.popup_en: Summary: each opening system has its own ideal setup for the minor pieces.
outro.popup: 总结：每种体系都有自己的轻子最优布置

moves.popup_en: d4! The Queen's Pawn Opening begins the London System.
moves.popup:
d4！皇后兵开局
伦敦体系开始

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's move and establishes a closed central structure.
moves.popup:
d5对称
封闭局面

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White's first minor piece reaches one of its best squares.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第1个轻子
马到最佳位置（f3是马最强格之一）

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's first minor piece.
moves.popup:
Nf6出动
黑方第1个轻子

moves.popup_en: Bf4! The London bishop reaches its characteristic square, controls e5, and is difficult to dislodge.
moves.popup:
Bf4！伦敦象
象到f4——伦敦体系特征格
控制e5，难以被驱赶

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position.
moves.popup: e6黑方稳固

moves.popup_en: e3 supports the center and prepares Bd3. White develops steadily in the closed setup.
moves.popup:
e3支撑
为Bd3做准备
封闭体系，稳步推进

moves.popup_en: ...Bd6 develops Black's bishop actively.
moves.popup: Bd6黑方象出动

moves.popup_en: Bxd6! White chooses a useful exchange, preventing Black's bishop from becoming active. This is a strategic simplification typical of the London.
moves.popup:
Bxd6！主动简化
防止黑方象活跃
伦敦体系的战略简化

moves.popup_en: ...Qxd6 recaptures, bringing Black's queen out early.
moves.popup:
Qxd6后接回
黑方后过早激活

moves.popup_en: Nbd2! The second knight develops to d2, the London System's flexible square rather than c3.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！第3个轻子（第2匹马）出动
注意：伦敦体系的马到d2而非c3
这是最优格，保持弹性

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup: O-O黑方易位

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White's bishop reaches its ideal square. All four minor pieces are now developed, so White can castle.
moves.popup:
Bd3！象出动到最佳格
白方4个轻子全部出动！
现在可以易位了

moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares to develop the bishop.
moves.popup: b6黑方让象出动

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles as soon as all four minor pieces are developed.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方易位
4个轻子全出后立即易位

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 activates the bishop on the long diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bb7黑方象激活
占据长对角线

moves.popup_en: c4 is a standard London plan, challenging Black's center.
moves.popup:
c4推进
伦敦体系标准计划
打击黑方中心

moves.popup_en: ...c5 counterattacks in the center.
moves.popup:
c5反推
黑方争中心

moves.popup_en: cxd5 simplifies the central tension.
moves.popup: cxd5简化

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 recaptures the pawn.
moves.popup: exd5接回

moves.popup_en: dxc5 captures on c5.
moves.popup: dxc5兑换

moves.popup_en: ...bxc5 recaptures and opens the b-file.
moves.popup: bxc5接回

moves.popup_en: Rc1! White activates the rook on the open file. Minor-piece development, castling, then rook activation: the correct development sequence is complete.
moves.popup:
Rc1！车激活！
车到c1占开放线
轻子全出→易位→现在重子激活
这是正确的出子顺序完整展示
